_note: good.md and fenced-gwt.md pass (fence lines are not items). adjective-ac.md item 3, 'Returns HTTP 200', PASSES on purpose: it records the stated residual — I1 catches adjectives, not criteria that cannot fail. feature-good-mixed.md and bounded-no-contract.md pass: a Contract that embeds real content (even alongside a link to the doc) is not link-only, and a non-feature lane is never asked for one. feature-link-only-long-url.md pins that a >4000-char URL in the link still leaves a link-only Contract/Verify caught — the word count doesn't grow with link length. feature-padded-link.md PASSES on purpose: it documents the known limitation that 8 words of filler in front of a link clears linkOnly()'s word floor. I1 catches linking instead of embedding by mistake, not gaming it on purpose — kept green so the gap is visible, not hidden. seams-one-field-good.md and seams-one-field-list-good.md pass (the merged Seams field: `none: <reason>`, or a list); -bare-none, -none-colon-empty, -prose and -padded fail on the field's shape, since no word count can pad past it. designation-trailer.md passes with a warning: a body whose last non-empty line starts `Per `. seams-one-field-bulleted-none and -bulleted-label fail: a leading bullet does not skip the reason test; -bulleted-none-reason passes. -none-dash and -none-dot fail (a reason holds a letter or digit); -ordered-good and -continuation-good pass; seams-heading-case-old-form.md passes, since the old form is found by the same reader as the section. The shapes the verify of the first fix found (-checkbox-none, -bold-none, -na, -dot, -two-labels, -bold-label) and `label:` with nothing after the colon (-label-empty) fail: every line is `label: detail` after its marker, checkbox and emphasis are taken off. -plus-list-good passes. A padded `a: b` still passes: the check holds the shape, not the meaning. The verify of the narrowing found HTML around a line (-html-label, -html-none, -html-detail, -entity-detail) and `none: <reason>` followed by a bad list line (-none-then-bad): all fail now. -html-in-reason-good passes. seams-one-field-none-wrapped-good.md passes: a `none: <reason>` may wrap onto a second line; only a list item after it fails (-none-then-bad). Reviews of #509 left the rest (#511): -ordered-paren-good passes (`1)` is a list as `1.` is). -none-of-label (`none of the above: …` is not the label `none`), -label-symbol (a label needs a letter or digit), -list-then-unlisted (a list, then a line outside it) and -unlisted-label (`who pays: …` with no list marker) each pin the clause that fails them. -na-detail-good and -none-na-good pass on purpose: `n/a` after a label says something, and whether it is true is for a reader. -none-invisible, -invisible-detail (U+3164), -bare-url (its colon is a URL's), fail. -none-then-none and -none-then-indented-item fail; -none-then-paragraph-good passes, since a `7.` cannot interrupt a paragraph. -html-attr-gt, -pi, -cdata, -doctype and -html-split-tag fail: the text they hold is not shown; -tick-in-attribute and -code-span-hides-tag fail: a backtick in a tag or across list items opens no code span; -none-then-zero-list fails (`01.` opens a list); -url-port, -url-colon-path and -mailto fail (a URL's colon is not the label's); -url-detail-good passes; -script-shown-good and -style-shown-good pass: GitHub shows `<script>` and `<style>` as text; -html-split-tag-good, -angle-detail-good and -code-tag-good pass: what is shown counts. Verify of the review fixes: -code-span-unclosed, -escaped-tick, -tick-run-no-closer, -code-span-block-end and -script-hyphen fail (a code span needs a closer of its own length in its own block; `<script-x>` is a custom element, hidden); -code-span-shown-good, -script-bare-good, -url-in-parens-good and -url-host-label-good pass (shown text counts; GitHub leaves a trailing `:` and `)` out of a link); -www-port and -xmpp fail (autolinks). Final review (#511): -single-quote-attr, -long-tag (no length bound), -tag-across-blank (a tag does not cross a blank line), and -span-ends-{blank,rule,dash,fence,tilde,div,setext,nav,pi,ordered} fail: a code span ends at a block start, so the tag after it is hidden; -visible-code-hash and -visible-code-seven pass (`#511` and `7.` start no block); -url-paren-good passes (an unbalanced `)` stays out of the link); -ftp-good passes (GitHub links only http(s), www., mailto: and xmpp:). -tag-across-blank-line fails the same way for a tag. Closing review (#511): -span-ends-{setext-dash,blank-spaces,source,table,heading,paren-list,close-div,indented}, -pi-across-blank and -cdata-across-blank fail (a code span ends at the block start; a PI or CDATA does not cross a blank line); -unquoted-attr, -self-closing, -tab-in-tag and -underscore-attr fail (tags GitHub hides); -none-then-blank-seven, -none-bold-second and -none-capital-second fail (after a blank line any number opens a list; `**none**:` and `None:` are second answers); -url-capital and -url-paren-colon fail (autolinks in capitals, a balanced paren); -declaration-lowercase-good and -declaration-digit-good pass (GitHub hides only a capitalised declaration); -none-wrapped-number-good, -heading-seven-good and -div-prefix-good pass (`1.5`, seven hashes and `<divx>` start no block). -declaration-capital-good passes: `<!Xtooling>` has no space after the name, so GitHub shows it. -quote-across-blank and -quote-across-blank-none fail (a quoted attribute value does not run past a blank line); -quote-with-other-quote-good passes (`it's` inside double quotes).
